title: Great Price!
text: Great Price!. These are the same silicon baking mats that I spent a fortune on years ago but for a very reasonable price. They are fantastic for baking.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Silicone, Non-Stick, Food Safe Baking Mat- Pack of 2
features: 2 non-stick silicone baking mats for easy and convenient baking, roasting and food prep
Non-stick silicone mats release food without the need for grease, cooking sprays, or parchment paper
Oven-safe up to 480 degrees F; easy to clean with soap and water
Each baking mat measures approximately 11.63 x 16.5 inches (LxW)
